description:
[The R-Rated Life in Paradise of a Young Lady Banished to the Countryside] 

A noble lady is cast aside and driven out to the countryside for failing to conceive. Her male servant, Dochi, joins her. But her life in exile, an exile that isn’t quite a typical exile, doesn’t end there. Just like the saying “a blessing in disguise,” goes, the second act of the young lady's life begins to unfold. Butcher Dunsoe, water carrier Seok, and her sturdy servant Dochi... 

Everywhere she looks, the men are well-built, strong, and virile. The only “problem”, if it can even be called that, is that they’re all lowborn. 

Right. What does it matter if they’re noblemen or lowborn? As long as their dicks are decent, that’s all that matters. I've been kicked out and rejected anyway, so I might as well enjoy this. There’s no way I could go back to Hanyang, anyway. 

Thus, the young lady's personal paradise unfolds.
